answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain protocol influence. Like the desolate tundra, this process leaves no trace for the attacker, imposing a real fiscal burden proportional to their desired stake. The cost is as rigid as ferrous metal, ensuring that identity creation is not a velvet operation but a calculated loss of capital, effectively disincentivizing the deployment of mass-produced, low-value bot identities.
